description: This file defines the 'Feed' controller class for the OpenCart administrative interface, managing CRUD operations (list, install, uninstall) for feed extensions within the admin panel.

classes.name: Feed
classes.description: Controller class for managing feed extensions in OpenCart's admin area, providing methods to list, install, and uninstall feed modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the list of feed extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for display of available and installed feed extensions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks user permissions for modifying feed extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installing a new feed extension and setting up necessary permissions and autoloaders.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a feed extension.
